subject: [PATCH v3 10/14] NFSD: stop registering with rpcbind after a failure in listener_set

2026-08-28.patch_summary: This patch addresses a performance issue in the NFSD (Network File System Daemon) code, where a silent rpcbind failure can cause the nfsd_mutex to be held for an extended period of time. The patch introduces a check for rpcbind failures and, if one occurs, it skips registering with rpcbind for subsequent listeners. This approach prevents the mutex from being held indefinitely and allows the system to recover more quickly in case of a failure.
